page.overview:
Who is Campylodoniscus?

is an extinct genus of titanosaur [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sauropoda sauropod] dinosaur that lived in Argentina during the Late Cretaceous period. Its fossils were found in the Bajo Barreal formation, which houses other sauropods like Andesaurus and Epachthosaurus.

Campylodoniscus is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia of the Jurassic Park Institute. Unfortunately, it hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006.
